explanation: This simp lemma says how the library's own definition checkerboardCyclicQuadraticIsometry acts on an element. Its proof applies FiniteQuadraticModule.cyclicIsometryOfGenerator_apply, which a grep shows is defined in the library itself (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/FiniteBilinearModule/Cyclic.lean), not in Mathlib. Mathlib has nothing corresponding to these objects (finite quadratic modules, the checkerboard discriminant group), so the statement's content lies entirely in the library's definitions.
